newsitem.title: DENMARK: Den Danske Bank opens new Oslo branch.
newsitem.headline: Den Danske Bank opens new Oslo branch.

text.p: Denmark's biggest bank, Den Danske Bank, said on Monday it opened a new branch in Oslo, Norway, with a 20-strong staff.

"Our Oslo branch will mainly advise and serve medium and large Norwegian business clients, offering them the full assortment of Danske Bank products as well as its own local commercial products," the bank said in a statement.

Den Danske Bank opened a representative office in the Norwegian capital in 1995. It already has branch offices in Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmo in Sweden and Helsinki in Finland. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
